title: Master Page - Verify that The user should not be able to delete columns that are already in use for a Data Source.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
User should redirect to the master page

steps.action: Delete the column row from the grid which is used in data source
steps.expectedResult: Error message populate and record should not be deleted.
